# artifactkeeper_migration_job (Resource)

A migration job against a `migration_source` connection. Terraform creates the job in a **pending** state; **it does not start it**. Start, pause, and cancel are separate imperative operations (run them from the UI or `POST /api/v1/migrations/{id}/start`). The job has no update endpoint, so any change forces a new job. Scope a job to specific repositories with `include_repos`; cached remote (proxy) artifacts are excluded unless `include_cached_remote` is set.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A migration job scoped to a single repository. Terraform creates it in a
# pending state; start it yourself (UI, or POST /api/v1/migrations/{id}/start).
resource "artifactkeeper_migration_job" "myrepo_npm" {
  source_connection_id = artifactkeeper_migration_source.nexus.id
  include_repos        = ["myrepo-npm"]

  # Proxy/cached-remote artifacts are excluded by default; hosted repos only.
  include_cached_remote = false
  conflict_resolution   = "skip"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `source_connection_id` (String) ID of the `migration_source` connection to migrate from.

### Optional

- `concurrent_transfers` (Number) Parallel transfer workers. Defaults to `4`.
- `conflict_resolution` (String) How to resolve artifacts that already exist, e.g. `skip` (default) or `overwrite`.
- `date_from` (String) Only migrate artifacts modified at or after this RFC 3339 timestamp.
- `date_to` (String) Only migrate artifacts modified at or before this RFC 3339 timestamp.
- `dry_run` (Boolean) Plan the migration without transferring anything. Defaults to `false`.
- `exclude_paths` (List of String) Artifact path globs to skip.
- `exclude_repos` (List of String) Repository keys to skip.
- `include_cached_remote` (Boolean) Migrate cached remote (proxy) artifacts. Defaults to `false`.
- `include_groups` (Boolean) Migrate groups. Defaults to `true`.
- `include_permissions` (Boolean) Migrate permissions. Defaults to `true`.
- `include_repos` (List of String) Repository keys to migrate. Empty migrates everything the connection exposes.
- `include_users` (Boolean) Migrate users. Defaults to `true`.
- `job_type` (String) Job type: `full`, `incremental`, or `assessment`. Defaults to `full`.
- `repo_mappings` (Map of String) Source repository key -> destination repository key rename map. Migrated artifacts land in the destination (target) repo instead of one named after the source, e.g. `{ "network-team-python" = "network-pypi" }`. Sources not listed keep their name. Pair with `include_repos` (which lists the *source* keys).
- `throttle_delay_ms` (Number) Delay between transfers, in milliseconds. Defaults to `100`.
- `verify_checksums` (Boolean) Verify transferred artifacts against source digests. Defaults to `true`.

### Read-Only

- `completed_items` (Number) Items migrated so far. Refreshed on read.
- `created_at` (String)
- `error_summary` (String) Error summary for a failed job. Refreshed on read.
- `estimated_time_remaining` (Number) Estimated seconds remaining (the backend may leave this null). Refreshed on read.
- `failed_items` (Number) Items that failed. Refreshed on read.
- `finished_at` (String) When the job finished, once finished. Refreshed on read.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `progress_percent` (Number) Migration progress percentage. Refreshed on read.
- `skipped_items` (Number) Items skipped. Refreshed on read.
- `started_at` (String) When the job started, once started. Refreshed on read.
- `status` (String) Job status (e.g. `pending`, `running`, `completed`, `failed`). Refreshed on read.
- `total_bytes` (Number) Total bytes to transfer. Refreshed on read.
- `total_items` (Number) Total items to migrate. Refreshed on read.
- `transferred_bytes` (Number) Bytes transferred so far. Refreshed on read.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import artifactkeeper_migration_job.myrepo_npm 6a1f0b93-2c7d-4e51-9a3f-8b0c1d2e3f40
```
